summary: Implemented Phase 1 isotropic material support with typed `Medium`/`PECMedium`/`PMCMedium` models, typed IR lowering, coefficient compilation, scene material sampling, and constitutive update helpers plus tests, docs, and an example.
key_findings: `autofdtd.materials` now exposes validated isotropic public models and normalization via `medium_model_from_value()`.
`autofdtd.ir` lowers supported isotropic media into typed `MediumIR`, `PECMediumIR`, and `PMCMediumIR` instead of generic medium envelopes.
`autofdtd.compiler.materials` compiles lossy-isotropic Yee coefficients and represents PEC/PMC as explicit clamp-zero constitutive modes.
`autofdtd.kernels.materials` provides staged electric and magnetic constitutive update helpers with a NumPy path and optional Warp-availability reporting.
Scene-level material application is now test-covered through point sampling and compiled-coefficient attachment across background and structure precedence.
Verification passed with `pytest -q` (65 passed) and `ruff check src tests`.

artifacts.description: Typed Phase 1 isotropic material models and coercion helpers.
Isotropic coefficient compilation and scene material sampling utilities.
Constitutive update helpers and backend metadata for isotropic material paths.
Typed isotropic medium IR models and lowering integration.
Serialization, validation, scene application, coefficient, IR, and constitutive-update coverage for isotropic materials.
Material-scope documentation for the new baseline isotropic family.

follow_up_notes: Warp is not installed in this environment, so the constitutive runtime path is currently exercised through the NumPy helper while preserving an explicit optional-Warp seam for later GPU kernel work.
